This is a quality product for a good price.  Unlike whole coconut oil, fractionated coconut oil can withstand light and high heat without going rancid, adding a longer shelf life. It is also lighter and not greasy, making it great to use as a carrier for essential oils.  The two main ways that I like to use is for a hair conditioner and also as a carrier oil mixing in different essential oils.  But I have also used it clean leather and wood.  I received this bottle securely packaged, undamaged a

This fractionated coconut oil is a great alternative in sterilizing minor scrapes!  Fractionated coconut oil, also called “liquid coconut oil,” is a form of the oil that has had the long-chain fatty acids removed via hydrolysis and steam distillation. Just this one change makes the oil liquid at room temperature, and extends the product’s shelf life. qa.q: Is it greasy or does it absorb quickly?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree: some say it is not greasy and absorbs instantly [1][2], while another says it takes a while for its greasiness to go away [4].

claims.text: It is lighter and not greasy.
It absorbs instantly with no greasy residue.
It takes a while for its greasiness to go away.

qa.q: Is it truly 100% pure fractionated coconut oil with no additives?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: Can I use it on my face without breaking out?
qa.answer: Reviews mention using it on the face and leaving skin soft and moisturized [1][2][6], but none specifically address whether it causes breakouts, so there is no direct evidence on that concern.
